open_points.subject: create-project retry after the created project changes
open_points.text: a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: What happens when the owner retries the original create after the first project still exists but one of its values has changed through an ordinary accepted action, rather than through erasure or anonymisation?
options: Return the existing project and make no second project
Refuse the retry and make no second project
Treat the retry as a new create and make a second project
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the retry and make no second project.

witness.initial: Project P was created from request R and still exists as a normal, non-erased project.
events: The owner corrects P's display name, moving its revision.
After losing or replaying an old response, the owner repeats create request R with its original values.
outcomes: Registry treats R as the same request and returns or refuses against P without creating another project.
Because P no longer keeps its original values, Registry treats R as a new create and creates project Q.
witness.observer: The owner, and any consumer listing or validating the resulting project identities.
